name: v1.0-beta integration, exact artifact evidence, and release candidate
record_pointer_convention: head_sha identifies the clean pre-handoff candidate tip used for the one-time build. The commit that adds this P19.json record is a pointer-only record commit and is excluded from the candidate source identity.

tests.summary: Release verifier, workflow boundary, and exact-artifact tests pass.
Full repository unit suite passes with the dedicated sandbox identity and test umask.
Full repository race suite passes without a reported data race.
Runner shell syntax and whitespace checks pass.
Local TCP/UDP and lifecycle walking-skeleton E2E passes.
Isolated Linux installer install, upgrade, rollback, role, and purge suite passes.

Go 1.26.6 candidate built once; exact local build, browser, vulnerability, functional, installer, security, race, vet, and evidence gates pass; unavailable external gates remain SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS.
Primary evidence bundle validates against the exact unsigned manifest.
A separate candidate run exercised detached Ed25519 signing with a temporary test key; it is not production signing evidence.
The test-root signed candidate verifies successfully; promotion remains blocked by missing approval and limited required gates.

candidate.evidence_digest_method: SHA-256 of sorted sha256sum lines for every regular file in the evidence directory.

known_limits: The primary candidate is unsigned because no production release signing key was available; no independent release approver was available.
The signed candidate used a temporary test Ed25519 key only to exercise the verifier path; it is not production trust evidence and is not promotable.
No independent public-WAN controller/probe vantage, real CPE/router matrix, native Windows runtime, native arm64/OpenRC host, registry OCI digest, or 24-hour soak was provisioned.
Local loopback, cross-build, isolated test-root installer, and local OCI evidence retain their actual evidence levels and do not promote runtime support.
The candidate bundles are external generated evidence at the recorded /tmp paths; no release binaries or generated logs were added to the source tree.

red_reasons.story_1: RED: the integrated tree had no P19 exact-artifact release record or verifier bound to a single manifest digest.
red_reasons.story_2: RED: the integrated tree had no one-time Linux/Windows candidate build, checksum set, SBOM, or detached release signature path.
red_reasons.story_3: RED: the integrated tree had no release runner recording functional, security, installer, platform, WAN, or soak gate evidence.
red_reasons.story_4: RED: external WAN, native platform, registry, and soak infrastructure was unavailable and remains explicitly limited; the refreshed local browser and vulnerability gates now pass.
red_reasons.story_5: RED: release evidence did not yet have structural path, artifact-digest, gate-evidence, or promotion verification tests.
red_reasons.story_6: RED: no immutable promotion workflow existed that downloads and signs an already-built candidate without rebuilding it.
red_reasons.story_7: RED: README/support status still described P19 as unstarted and did not reflect the integrated P18 evidence limits.

ownership_transfers.reason: P19 exact-artifact candidate build, gate orchestration, release evidence verification, path-boundary hardening, and protected promotion workflow.
ownership_transfers.boundary: No internal production package or frozen API/protocol contract was changed.

ownership_transfers.reason: P19 release, NAT support, rollback, promotion, and evidence status documentation.
ownership_transfers.boundary: Claims remain limited to the recorded P18/P19 evidence; no GA SLO or global reachability claim was added.

ownership_transfers.reason: P19 security-gate remediation pins the fixed Go 1.26.6 toolchain and keeps CI/platform evidence on the same patched runtime.
ownership_transfers.boundary: Only toolchain and workflow metadata changed; no internal production package or frozen product contract changed.

cleanup_notes: The diagnostic duplicate runner was stopped. The final unsigned primary bundle and non-sensitive public test key/evidence are intentionally retained at the recorded paths; the temporary private test key is removed after signing-path verification. Browser temporary state was cleaned after the PASS run; scanner tooling remains outside the repository.
